name: Adept spectral modulation in v space
plain: Reworks the guidance difference in the frequency domain before applying the scale. It is converted to v-prediction first, using the same conversion as RescaleCFG. Amplitudes in the top and bottom percentile of log amplitude are adjusted. Docstring credits ComfyUI-Latent-Modifiers.
math:
x=x_in/(σ²+1). v_c,v_u=((x−(x_in−c))√(σ²+1))/σ, likewise u. Δ=v_c−v_u.
F=FFT2(Δ), log|F| with quantiles at p and 1−p, percent p default 5.
v=v_u+s·iFFT(F·mult); return x_in−(x−vσ/√(σ²+1)).
Mult details beyond the quantiles (utils.py line 490 on) not read.
label: from code
surprise: Applies a VE v-prediction conversion with no branch for flow models.
